title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics; parity fixes + version bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Ayesha Rao
description:
Context / Motivation:
We maintain three language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) but have drift in auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This causes customer confusion and subtle bugs in production (token refresh semantics, inconsistent retryable errors, and incompatible streaming callbacks).

What this PR does (single summary):
- Standardizes auth header handling and token refresh across SDKs: introduces a shared refresh flow and clear hook for custom token providers.
- Unifies retry semantics: common default RetryPolicy (idempotency-aware, exponential backoff with jitter), adds 429/503 retries, and exposes retry config in all SDKs.
- Improves streaming ergonomics: a consistent streaming client interface with typed event wrappers, backpressure API, and automatic reconnect/resume for SSE/WS transports.
- Parity fixes and naming alignment: harmonizes parameter names (model, input/prompt, max_new_tokens), deprecates legacy aliases with warnings, and aligns method signatures across languages.
- Version bumps: python -> 1.12.0, typescript -> 0.9.4, go -> v0.8.1.

Why:
- Reduces cognitive overhead for integrators using multiple SDKs and makes server behavior more predictable under load.
- Fixes customer-reported regressions where streaming reconnects lost events and where retried idempotent operations occasionally caused duplicate side-effects.

Implementation notes / high-level changes (by SDK):
- Python:
  - Introduced redwood.sdk.auth.AuthProvider interface and default TokenRefreshProvider that hooks into requests.Session headers.
  - Central RetryPolicy under redwood.sdk.retries with backoff/jitter and idempotency map.
  - Streaming: new StreamingClient with on_event/on_error/on_close callbacks and an iterator helper for sync/async usage.
  - Tests: added unit tests for token refresh, retry windowing, and SSE reconnects.

- TypeScript:
  - Added AuthProvider type and unified fetch wrapper in packages/sdk-core.
  - RetryPolicy added to packages/sdk-core with same defaults as Python.
  - StreamingClient: Observable-based API plus convenience async iterator pattern.
  - Docs updated in docs/sdk/typescript.md to show new ergonomics and migration tips.

- Go:
  - Introduced AuthProvider interface with pluggable TokenSource.
  - RetryPolicy implementation mirrors behavior in other SDKs; configurable via client options.
  - Streaming: channel-based events and helper that returns a resumed stream when reconnecting.

Commit summary:
- feat(sdk): add shared RetryPolicy and idempotency mapping across SDKs
- feat(py): add AuthProvider + TokenRefreshProvider; StreamingClient (sync/async)
- feat(ts): add AuthProvider type, fetch wrapper, Observable streaming API
- feat(go): add TokenSource + streaming resume helper
- chore: bump versions (py 1.12.0 / ts 0.9.4 / go v0.8.1)
- test: add retry/streaming unit tests + CI matrix entry

Files changed (high level):
- sdk/python/redwood/sdk/auth.py
- sdk/python/redwood/sdk/retries.py
- sdk/python/redwood/sdk/streaming.py
- sdk/python/setup.cfg (version)
- sdk/typescript/packages/sdk-core/src/auth.ts
- sdk/typescript/packages/sdk-core/src/retries.ts
- sdk/typescript/packages/sdk-core/src/streaming.ts
- sdk/typescript/packages/sdk-core/package.json (version)
- sdk/go/redwood/auth.go
- sdk/go/redwood/retries.go
- sdk/go/redwood/streaming.go
- docs/sdk/CHANGELOG.md
- tests/* (unit tests added/updated)

CI notes:
- Initial CI run: windows-python streaming tests flaky -> rerun.
- After fixing a race in streaming reconnect backoff, full matrix passed (linux/mac/windows, py/ts/go).

Migration / compatibility:
- No breaking changes by default. Legacy aliases remain with deprecation warnings for one release cycle.
- Clients using custom retry hooks should migrate to the new RetryPolicy interface; helper adapters included in this PR.

Release notes:
- SDKs: unified auth + retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity across py/ts/go, version bumps. See docs/sdk/CHANGELOG.md for upgrade instructions.

review_comments: Luca Bianchi: Please add a short note in the changelog about the token refresh hook usage in hosted vs private deployments.
Ayesha Rao (author): Added changelog note and doc snippet showing example TokenRefreshProvider configuration.
Maya Chen: The retry defaults look aggressive for non-idempotent ops; please ensure non-idempotent endpoints default to no-retry.
Ayesha Rao (author): Confirmed - RetryPolicy uses idempotency map; non-idempotent ops opt-in. Added tests to assert no retry on POST /transactions.
Ethan Park: Found a race in the streaming reconnect backoff that could drop the last event; pushed a small fix and added a test to reproduce the race.
Maya Chen: Approving after tests pass and changelog updated.
Luca Bianchi: Squash-merge to keep history tidy. Approved.
release_notes:
- Unify auth handling across SDKs with pluggable TokenRefreshProvider.
- Add consistent RetryPolicy with idempotency-aware defaults (retries for 429/503).
- Improve streaming ergonomics (typed events, backpressure API, automatic reconnect/resume).
- Parity fixes across Python/TypeScript/Go; deprecate legacy aliases with warnings.
- SDK versions bumped: python 1.12.0, typescript 0.9.4, go v0.8.1.
notes_for_cherrypick: No cherrypick needed for release-branches; changes are non-breaking and covered by integration tests. If backporting, ensure streaming reconnect fix (commit 5) is included.
